DIAGNOSIS READY: Patellofemoral Pain Syndrome (Runner's Knee)

The clinical picture of recent increased volleyball activity, anterior knee pain exacerbated by stairs/squatting, and absence of mechanical locking or significant swelling is classic for PFPS. The Knee X-Ray was appropriately negative for fracture or advanced arthritis. No further imaging is required at this time; I will recommend a trial of physical therapy focusing on hip and quadriceps strengthening along with activity modification.
